Gallatin is rebuilding logistics infrastructure for United States and allied national security missions through AI systems that improve logistics decision-making. The Backend Software Engineer will design, build, and scale reliable backend services, APIs, and data pipelines for Gallatin’s AI-driven logistics platform, while collaborating across engineering and product teams and supporting continuous improvement.

Responsibilities
Create scalable, resilient backend services and APIs for our logistics solutions
Own system architecture, balancing performance, scalability, and security
Partner with front-end, AI/ML, and product teams to integrate services smoothly
Drive high availability and reliability through proactive monitoring, logging, and alerting
Build and maintain thorough testing strategies (unit, integration, and performance) to keep the platform stable
Develop pipelines that ingest data from real-time, batch, structured, and unstructured sources
Ensure data is consistent, reliable, and available through thoughtful schema design and database optimization
Contribute to code reviews, coding standards, best practices, and documentation
Track backend development trends and introduce improvements to our stack where they make sense
Support the onboarding and mentoring of new teammates as the team grows

Required
Proficiency in one or more backend languages: Python, Node.js, Typescript or Java
Solid understanding of API design and implementation (REST, GraphQL)
Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Experience deploying and running containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes
Understanding of infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Experience with software testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end testing)
A commitment to writing clean, maintainable, well-documented code
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex systems
Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain technical concepts clearly
Passion for continuous learning and staying current with the latest advancements in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure, as well as a commitment to mentoring and teaching others
U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin
Preferred
Experience with building and integrating on Palantir Foundry and its various offerings
Knowledge of defense or logistics industries and legacy system modernization
Contributions to open-source software or active engagement with the developer community
